basis: Existing formal_harm_boundary: preserve stopped lineage, report budget-limited scope, continue independent controls; no scientific rule changed
exact_budget_groups: A three-seed fixed-endpoint estimate requires all three actual checkpoints at that endpoint. Never omit stopped seeds, copy earlier outputs to a higher-step alias, interpolate or fill expected results.
absent_endpoints: Higher fixed endpoints after registered harm stopping remain NOT_RUN. Report every stopped seed, actual step/scores and harm record.
optional_stopping_strategy: A separately named final strategy may group each seeds last actual policy under the registered stopping rule; list all actual steps/scores and call it a budget-cap stopping strategy, never equal actual scoring budget.
final_test: Lock unique actual developed checkpoints and their roles before any final Navtest; repeated use in analysis groups does not create new training seeds.
